author: GadgetBug
expect: each guide board should rank at or near the top of what the engine finds from its starting hand

boards.name: banish TDdark
boards.notes: Most common play in Thunder Dragon.

boards.name: banish TDdark + OG/TDF
boards.notes:
This combo can be done by having OG somewhere, e.g. banish with Crossout Designator.

Its one less draw vs Maxx C compared to using TDhawk and you get TDF as follow-up.

boards.name: TDdark + banish TDroar
boards.notes: Important to incorporate into other lines.

boards.name: TDhawk + banish TDroar
boards.notes: Important to incorporate into other lines.

boards.name: OG + banish TDroar
boards.notes: Important to incorporate into other lines.

boards.name: Hand full of ThunDras
boards.notes:
Its a greedy combo but you kinda have to go for it when your hand doesn't have strong cards, it plays poorly into blowouts like Fuwalos and Maxx "C" as well as Nibiru. 

It does give options if they use a disruption on Solar, as you can make Colossus and get TDF in GY.

boards.name: TDF Follow-up play
boards.notes:
This is the basic Thunder Dragon resource Loop.
 
Using a Bystial to banish TDdark during their turn can also help adding the pieces.

boards.name: Solar + Bystial + out to Fuwa
boards.notes: You can use a bystial in hand too, which means you can keep the W:P and use Bystial + Colossus for S:P so W:P can negate something.

boards.name: Solar + Bystial
boards.notes:
- This is assuming you don't have an out to Maxx c/Fuwalos.

- If the Bystial isn't Druis or Baldrake, you can use it as Material for I:P and use Solar for a 2nd Colossus.

boards.name: Noroi + lv5
boards.notes: This same combo works with Jokul + lv5 but it plays into Droll or you don't end on Ripper.

boards.name: Solar + Bystial (Saryuja)
boards.notes: This is very dependent on the hand, what you draw and the opponent not having hand traps, so its good to look what they have if possible, or just blindly try to have as many hand traps as possible, between Bystials, Izuna, Ash, Droll, Maxx c, or even set cards like Droplet.

boards.name: 2.5c White Albaz + Solar
boards.notes:
Retribution isn't a core card, you can also add Branded Fusion for follow-up instead.

TDdark being drawn means you can start with Solar to bait a hand trap.
field: The Dragon that Devours the Dogma
guessed: The Dragon that Devours the Dogma

boards.name: White Albaz + OG
boards.notes:
There are better things you can do with the Fusion plays depending on the other draws.

You could also tribute OG over the Albaz to make Colossus, this line gives more options.

boards.name: WAlbaz + TDdark
boards.notes: Playing The Golden Swordsoul makes drawing WAlbaz no require a lv4 or extender to start the engine, but its a bad draw, so only recommended if you play more ways to add WAlbaz.
field: The Dragon that Devours the Dogma
guessed: The Dragon that Devours the Dogma

boards.name: Cartesia + Bystial + LIGHT/DARK
boards.notes: Check the Basic line tab in the Spreadsheet to optimize the line to what else you drew.

boards.name: Branded Fusion + discard
boards.notes: You shouldn't use this line most of the time, as any Bystial, a light monster or a way to Thunder Dragondark makes the line much better.

boards.name: BF + TDdark
boards.notes:
If you didn't normal summon Batteryman Solar to get to TDdark, you can play around Nibiru by skipping steps 6-7.

You can also just add TDhawk instead of TDroar (to keep TDroar in deck.

boards.name: BF vs DiFi/Macro
boards.notes:
It doesn't uses your normal summon, so you can bait out stuff earlier and it will enable other plays later like TF&TV or WAlbaz.

You can do the same going 1st but making Dragostapelia if it was Dimensional Shifter.

boards.name: BF + Lubellion
boards.notes: If different Bystial you just don't get to Regained.

boards.name: Solar + OG/TDdark + TF&TV
boards.notes:
Something you will do if your hand doesn't have Bystials or hand traps/backrow.

If you do have good non-engine, and its OG and not TDdark, you can summon TDdark with TDroar's eff (Step 6) and use TDdark to add TDF, which makes Titan (or 3rd Colossus) for a better follow-up.

boards.name: Zombie Vampire into Combo
boards.notes:
This make so you have 3 targets you can mill, meaning between the 5 cards in hand, deck thinning to find 3 Solar, 3 TDdark or 1-2 TDroar.

If you have a Bystial you can also choose to summon smth else from the GY, maybe to get value or prevent the opponent from triggering their effects.

boards.name: Millenium + TDdark/TDroar
boards.notes:
The priority if you draw multiple pieces is: Sengenjin> Wedju > Golem.

Sengenjin can add itself but it can't place itself multiple times in the S/T.

boards.name: Millenium into ZVamp
field: Golem that Guards the Millennium Treasures

boards.name: DMGMA into ZVamp
start: Dark Magician Girl the Magician's Apprentice

boards.name: Crackle + Whisker + Solar + Baldrake
boards.notes:
This is to highlight plays going 2nd.

Crack eff can summon Solar or a ThunDra to start your plays, any Bystial to trigger your ThunDra is an option to use in their end phase.

Whisker in the end phase is also very strong and can be better most of the time.
